predictions.description: Per-design structure-prediction records (e.g. AF2/Protenix outputs with pLDDT, pTM, ipTM, PAE summaries). Each row is keyed by an identifier the joiner can match against `analyses`/`qc_results`/`candidates`.

analyses.description: Per-design structural-analysis records (e.g. interface contacts, RMSD, ipSAE).

qc_results.description: Per-design quality-control records (e.g. protein_qc metrics: pI, GRAVY, polybasic clusters).

candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] or legacy candidate records carrying identifier and supplementary scores to merge into ranking.

top_k.description: Number of top-ranked candidates to keep after weighted ranking.

output_prefix.description: Filename prefix for the generated ranking TSV/JSON artifacts. Must be filesystem-safe.
